title_html: Fulfilled by TikTok vs 3PL vs Self-Ship: How 8-Figure Brands Choose
description: Fulfilled by TikTok vs 3PL vs self-ship: how established brands compare cost per order, eligibility and account-health risk before picking a TikTok Shop model.
dek: Fulfilled by TikTok, a 3PL and shipping it yourself each move a different risk onto your TikTok Shop. Here is how we compare them on cost per order, eligibility and account health — for brands that already have volume.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: Pick the fulfillment model that protects your account and your margin.
llms_summary: A decision guide for established brands choosing between Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT), a third-party logistics provider and self-shipping on TikTok Shop. FBT earns a Free 3-Day Delivery tag and excludes most logistics issues from seller performance metrics, but pricing sits on a published rate card that TikTok has changed several times in 2026. 3PL and self-ship keep control and cost flexibility but leave Late Dispatch Rate (2 business day dispatch SLA, 4% recommended, enforcement above 10%) and on-time delivery on the seller's account.
